item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las brtan ma'i zlog pa dal khram gting zlog
item.coloph: brtan ma'i dal khram gting zlog zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen pos phyi rabs don du mdzad// snyan rgyud/ dam nyams log lta can la ma shor cig las ldan zung thub bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa/ des rnyed bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par shog ces gsungs nas yum cig ye shes mtsho rgyal (la) gnyer gtad do/ yum chen gyi (gyis) stang chen dmu tsa la bstan pa'i gnyer gtad do/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel bar shog/
